description: Nesting-depth boundary of the persona-binary writer (docs/SCHEMA.md §3.4 rule 2): 1000 nested array/map levels encode, 1001 are rejected (which also turns a cyclic value graph into a hard error instead of a stack overflow). The schemas are given as generatedSchema (see vectors/README.md).

vectors.description: 1000 nested single-element arrays around an int encode: exactly at the limit, which §3.4 rule 2 must accept.
1001 nested arrays exceed the 1000-level limit and are rejected before any byte is written.
